description: A loop binding that starts as [] gets its element type from recur, so a field read before the recur in source order checks and runs.
program: (loop {:max 5} [todo ["a" "b"] reserved []] (if (= (count todo) 0) {:total (reduce (fn [s r] (+ s (get r :size))) 0 reserved) :ids (map (fn [r] (get r :id)) reserved)} (recur (rest todo) (concat reserved [{:id (first todo) :size (get (call store.get {:id (first todo)}) :size)}]))))
